map.CU = 1 − Σ|x_i − x̄| / (n × x̄)：实测值与均值偏差: CU = 1 − Σ|x_i − x̄| / (n × x̄): the smaller the deviation of the measured values from the mean, the more uniform the distribution.
map.CU ≥ 0.85 为优，0.75~0.85 可接受，低于需调喷头/压力。: CU >= 0.85 is excellent, 0.75-0.85 acceptable, and below that the nozzles or pressure need adjusting.
map.CU 和分布均匀系数 DU 一样吗？: Is CU the same as the distribution uniformity coefficient DU?
map.→ 打开灌溉均匀度（克里斯琴森系数）计算工具: -> Open the irrigation uniformity (Christiansen coefficient) calculator tool
map.不同。CU 用全部测点均值，DU（如 Christiansen 的变体或低四分位: They differ. CU uses the mean of all measurement points, while DU (such as the Christiansen variant or the low quartile DU_lq) commonly uses the mean of the lowest quarter of the points, which is stricter and better reflects supply to the worst-served areas.
map.先查系统压力是否均衡、喷头是否堵塞或型号不一、支管首末端压力降。多数情况是压力不: First check whether the system pressure is even, whether the nozzles are blocked or of mixed types, and the pressure drop from the start to the end of the submain. In most cases uneven pressure or nozzle wear is the cause.
map.克里斯琴森均匀系数：Cu = [1 − Σ|xi − x̄| ÷ (n × x̄: Christiansen uniformity coefficient: Cu = [1 − Σ|xi − x̄| ÷ (n × x̄)] × 100%. xi is the water collected at each point, x̄ the average, and n the number of points. The closer Cu is to 100% the more uniform the irrigation; sprinkler systems generally require >=80% and drip >=90%. A large deviation indicates uneven network pressure or blocked emitters, and it is used for system acceptance and uniformity diagnosis.
